RUN |1 MISE_VERSION=2026.9.15 /bin/sh -c if [ -z "$MISE_VERSION" ] || [ -z "$(echo $MISE_VERSION | tr -d ' ')" ]; then   echo "ERROR: MISE_VERSION build argument is required and cannot be empty!" >&2;   echo "Usage: docker build --build-arg MISE_VERSION=yourversion ..." >&2;   exit 1; fi # buildkit

ENV MISE_INSTALL_PATH=/usr/local/bin/mise MISE_VERSION=2026.9.15 MISE_SELF_UPDATE_AVAILABLE=false MISE_DATA_DIR=/mise MISE_CONFIG_DIR=/mise MISE_CACHE_DIR=/mise/cache PATH=/mise/shims:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin

RUN |1 MISE_VERSION=2026.9.15 /bin/sh -c gpg --keyserver hkps://keys.openpgp.org --recv-keys 24853EC9F655CE80B48E6C3A8B81C9D17413A06D &&   curl https://mise.jdx.dev/install.sh.sig | gpg --decrypt > install_mise.sh &&   MISE_DEBUG=true MISE_INSTALL_MUSL=1 sh ./install_mise.sh &&   rm install_mise.sh &&   gpg --batch --yes --delete-keys 24853EC9F655CE80B48E6C3A8B81C9D17413A06D &&   rm -rf /root/.gnupg/openpgp-revocs.d/* # buildkit

RUN |1 MISE_VERSION=2026.9.15 /bin/sh -c apt-get update && apt-get install -y     build-essential     cmake     make     pkg-config     autoconf     automake     libtool     git     libssl-dev     openssl     gnupg     ca-certificates     zlib1g-dev     libbz2-dev     liblzma-dev     libzstd-dev     libreadline-dev     libsqlite3-dev     libncursesw5-dev     xz-utils     tk-dev     libxml2-dev     libicu-dev     libxmlsec1-dev     libffi-dev     libjpeg-dev     libpng-dev     libtiff-dev     default-libmysqlclient-dev     libpq-dev     jq     curl     wget     zip     unzip     ssh     rsync     tzdata     locales &&     rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* # buildkit
